messages:
Ivy (Growth): morning team - FYI weekly KPI email shows a 12% dip in MQL->SQL conversion this week. flagging before we send. anyone else seeing it? :wave:
Noah (Analytics): yep I noticed. initial glance suggests GA4 event deduplication rules started applying yesterday, which is dropping our 'form_submit' counts where both server and client fires occur.
Priya (Demand Gen): we turned on server-side tagging for cleaner attribution. did we coordinate the event names?
Noah (Analytics): there's the catch. server tag sends event `form_submit_server` and client still sends `form_submit`. our GA4 filter treats these as separate but downstream model dedupes by event_name + user_pseudo_id; the new dedupe window is 10s which is excluding some.
Eric (Ops): sequence from logs: client ping at t, server ping at t+2s. older dedupe window was 30s. who changed it? :thinking_face:
Noah (Analytics): Data infra rolled a config change last night to tighten dedupe to 10s to reduce synthetic duplicates from bots. that inadvertently clipped legitimate server-client pairs.
Ivy (Growth): so our KPI deck used deduped numbers (post-dedupe) and under-reported. we need both raw and deduped for comms.
Jules (Content): pause the weekly snapshot email. we can't send a KPI that later flips.
KPI-Bot: alert triggered: ga4-dedupe-window changed to 10s at 1758009950 by infra-automation. See /incidents/1758009950 for details.
Priya (Demand Gen): immediate ask: can Noah run a quick compare: raw_count vs deduped_10s vs deduped_30s for the past 7 days and post the small table here?
Noah (Analytics): running now. SQL snippet I'm using:
```
SELECT date(event_timestamp) as day,
       count(*) as raw_submits,
       count(distinct CASE WHEN within_10s THEN event_id END) as deduped_10s,
       count(distinct CASE WHEN within_30s THEN event_id END) as deduped_30s
FROM ga4_events
WHERE event_name LIKE 'form_submit%'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 7;
```
Noah (Analytics): quick results pasted: average raw=1,200/day, deduped_30s=1,180/day, deduped_10s=1,050/day (this week dips by ~12% vs baseline).
Ivy (Growth): that's significant. Priya if we pause the email, redo the deck with both deduped_10s and deduped_30s columns and a footnote explaining the GA4 dedupe change, can we still ship Friday OK?
Priya (Demand Gen): yes pause for today. will wait for Noah's chart and then circulate updated copy.
Eric (Ops): rolling back dedupe window to 30s for the pipeline now (hotfix) and will follow up with a config PR to add a canary. ETA 25m.
KPI-Bot: deploy notice: ga4-config rollback queued by Eric at 1758010120.
Noah (Analytics): pushing temp dashboard showing raw vs deduped_10s vs deduped_30s: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/panels/1901/ga4-dedupe-compare.png
Jules (Content): thanks. I updated the KPI email draft: added a transparent note - "This week's reported MQL->SQL reflects GA4 deduplication policy change; normalized figures using previous dedupe window shown for continuity." keeping language short.
Priya (Demand Gen): one more ask for the postmortem: list the touchpoints that now go server-side and make a small checklist so future infra changes are coordinated.
Ivy (Growth): yes add to post-launch checklist: 1) server/client event name parity 2) dedupe window test 3) staging smoke test for KPI deck.
Eric (Ops): rollback succeeded at 1758010280. pipeline metrics should reflect previous numbers within 15m.
Noah (Analytics): re-run shows deduped_30s numbers back to baseline. I'll update the KPI deck with both metrics and a short explainer.
Ivy (Growth): great work. once updated, Priya will sign off and we send the email. closing thread when that's live. thanks all :raised_hands:
